li.Description: This is a description. Edit TagCategoriesEditable.xml to create your own tag categories.

li.Name: Other_category
li.Description: This is a second example category.

li.Name: Sexuality
li.Description: Gender identity of focus, or sexual identity of sex act (cis male, lesbian, et.c.).
Tag every gender that is being focused on. A faceless, offscreen, or subtly drawn individual should not be tagged.
Tag all gender identities and body types not implied by the previous.
Tag whether the action is homosexual, heterosexual, et.c..

li.Name: Feature
li.Description: Feature in image, like a choker, or a motorcycle.
Tag any anatomical anomalies.
Tag any outstanding body types, including physique and body hair.
Tag any genitalia, including tentacles.
Tag any special cutaway views, positions, and focuses on specific body parts.
Tag any unusual state or infliction on a body.
Tag any toys seen or used.
Tag any accessories, clothing, fashion, or body modification like tattoos.
Tag anything special about the setting or location.

li.Name: Act
li.Description: An action, sex act or position.

Tag all sex positions. Note that teasing a position does not count; for example, if one person is laying down and another is sitting upright on their lap, it is not cowgirl because there is no penetration.
Tag any sexual acts or penetrations not implied by the position.
Tag any special aspects of the sex happening, like emotions, rape, casual sex, incest, et.c..
Tag any accessory actions, like kissing, threatening, or hurting.
Tag any dominance.

li.Name: Meta
li.Description: Concepts that aren't actually in the media, like point of view.
Tag any camera angles and the point of view.
Tag what type of layout or structure the content has.
Tag all audible features.

li.Name: Artstyle
li.Description: Style of art.
Tag art styles, like anime for example.
Tag whether composition is 2d, 3d, pixels, painted, et.c..
Tag general aspects of the overall style.

li.Name: Species
li.Description: Species or species-specific features.
Tag any species if not implied by the characters you tagged.

li.Name: Character
li.Description: Character.
Tag every relevant character and living creature.

li.Name: Ip
li.Description: Franchise, universe, or IP.
Tag any IPs not implied by the characters or species. For example, a stormtrooper in its armor would be tagged 'Star_Wars'.

li.Name: Artist
li.Description: Artist.
